name: Kapospula (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, green at the hoist and red at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kapospula (a blue shield with a white cross and yellow charges) above the name KAPOSPULA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
